_what: the owner's rulings over the source lists — a rename (the id changes, the old spelling stays as an alias), an alias (another spelling for an existing row), a dropped id (refused with the reason), a status ruling. elements.py build applies these to the library; the source list is never touched. Keys are element/asset.
_rule: An id is lowercase with '-' between words, never squashed. Every old spelling is an alias on its row, so the tools that still write it resolve to the same row (Master Plan v2, 3.1, 2026-09-28).

dropped.mixed: not a format — a label for a swipe that had no one format. Tag each asset with its real format instead (Cleanup Plan decision 8, 25 Sep).

us-vs-them.note: Decision 8: `faceoff` (10 live ads of one brand) maps here — a split of every other fix against ours is the same shape as the shelf against the one product.

sales-page.note: The pages machine (classify_pages.py) still writes `salespage`; it resolves here through the alias.
